label: pass
title: README mentions `npm start` but there is no start script
body: The README says you can start the API with `npm start`, but package.json has no `start` script so the command fails with "Missing script: start". Add a start script that runs the server (src/server.js).
plan:
Add a start script to package.json so README's npm start works. This adds a script that runs the server (src/server.js) using node (package.json already uses ESM via "type":"module").
1. Add start script to package.json
requirements: Add a "start" script to package.json that runs the server (src/server.js) using node so npm start does not fail.
Do not change any other behavior or tests.
Ensure the start command works with the repository's ESM setup (package.json has "type":"module").
summary:
Added a "start" script to package.json that runs the server (node src/server.js). Verified by running the test suite (npm test --silent) to ensure no new failures were introduced; the suite still has the same pre-existing failing test (divide by zero throws RangeError) and all other tests pass.

Requirements:
1. R1: start script added in package.json (line in file: "start": "node src/server.js")
2. R2: No other behavior or tests changed (only package.json scripts updated)
3. R3: Start command uses node and is compatible with ESM via package.json's "type":"module"
patch:
diff --git a/package.json b/package.json
index 3e89e46..31ec720 100644
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@
   "type": "module",
   "main": "src/server.js",
   "scripts": {
+    "start": "node src/server.js",
     "test": "node --test"
   },
   "engines": {
verify: npm test --silent: exit before=1 after=1; no new test failures
